description: manni docs meta/schemas/field-location, run in a repo whose schema marks owner and authors external while two pages carry them.

steps.description: validate: both pages pass, with three location:external warnings.

runShell.stdio: /"owner" is stored in the page; steward\.schema\.json prefers external metadata\. Run manni meta relocate\.[\s\S]*2 files checked, 2 passed, 0 failed, 0 errors, 3 warnings/

steps.description: The github reporter annotates each as a warning on the value's line.

runShell.stdio: /Would create site\.metadata\.yaml; collections\[site\]\.externalMetadata\[0\] would own owner, authors\.[\s\S]*2 files, 3 values would move to 1 manifest/
/Created site\.metadata\.yaml[\s\S]*2 files, 3 values moved to 1 manifest/

steps.description: validate now reads owner and authors from the manifest and reports nothing.
